name: affiliations
description: List of objects, representing the affiliations this author has claimed in their publications.

fields.name: institution
fields.description: A dehydrated Institution object

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the institution. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315

fields.name: ror
fields.description: ROR ID of the institution. Example: https://ror.org/00jmfr291

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the institution. Example: University of Michigan–Ann Arbor

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Country of the institution (ISO alpha-2). Example: US

fields.name: type
fields.description: Institution type (ROR vocabulary). Possible values: education | healthcare | company | archive | nonprofit | government | facility | funder | other

fields.name: lineage
fields.description: OpenAlex IDs of this institution and all its parent institutions. Example: ["https://openalex.org/I27837315"]

fields.name: years
fields.description: A list of the years in which this author claimed an affiliation with this institution Example: [2016, 2015]

name: block_key
description: Name-based blocking key OpenAlex uses to group candidate profiles during author disambiguation.

name: cited_by_count
description: The total number  Works that cite a work this author has created. Example: 6500

name: counts_by_year
description: Author.works_count and Author.cited_by_count for each of the last ten years, binned by year.

fields.name: year
fields.description: The year the counts refer to. Example: 2024

fields.name: works_count
fields.description: Number of works the author published in that year. Example: 3

fields.name: cited_by_count
fields.description: Citations the author's works received in that year. Example: 410

fields.name: oa_works_count
fields.description: Number of open access works by this author in the given year. Example: 3

name: created_date
description: The date this Author object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. Example: 2017-08-08

name: display_name
description: The name of the author as a single string. Example: Heather Piwowar

name: display_name_alternatives
description: Other forms of this author's name found by OpenAlex in source metadata. Example: ["H. Piwowar", "Heather A. Piwowar"]

name: id
description: The OpenAlex ID for this author. Example: https://openalex.org/A5023888391

name: ids
description: Persistent identifiers OpenAlex holds for this author, keyed by namespace. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible. ids.openalex equals id.

fields.name: openalex
fields.description: The OpenAlex ID, same as id. Example: https://openalex.org/A5023888391

fields.name: orcid
fields.description: ORCID iD of the author, as a URL. Example: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1613-5981

fields.name: scopus
fields.description: Scopus author profile URL (legacy).

fields.name: twitter
fields.description: Twitter/X profile (legacy).

fields.name: wikipedia
fields.description: Wikipedia page URL.

fields.name: mag
fields.description: Microsoft Academic Graph ID (legacy).

name: last_known_institutions
description: This author's last known institutional affiliation(s): the affiliation on the author's most recently published work that has one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the institution. Example: https://openalex.org/I27837315

fields.name: ror
fields.description: ROR ID of the institution. Example: https://ror.org/00jmfr291

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the institution.

fields.name: country_code
fields.description: Country of the institution (ISO alpha-2). Example: DE, US, GB

fields.name: type
fields.description: Institution type (ROR vocabulary). Possible values: education | healthcare | company | ...

fields.name: lineage
fields.description: OpenAlex IDs of this institution and all its parent institutions. Example: ["https://openalex.org/I27837315"]

name: orcid
description: The ORCID for this author. ORCID global and unique ID for authors. Example: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1613-5981

name: observed_orcids
description: Every ORCID iD trusted on this author’s works, as URLs, with the primary orcid always first. Example: ["https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1613-5981"]

name: raw_author_names
description: The exact raw author-name strings, as they appeared on the source works, that were clustered into this author during disambiguation. Example: ["Piwowar, Heather", "H. A. Piwowar"]

name: summary_stats
description: Citation metrics for this author.

fields.name: 2yr_mean_citedness
fields.description: The 2-year mean citedness for this author. Also known as impact factor. Example: 3.14

fields.name: h_index
fields.description: The h-index for this author. Example: 42

fields.name: i10_index
fields.description: The i-10 index for this author. Example: 120

name: updated_date
description: The last time anything in this author object changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts. Example: 2026-10-12T05:31:44.211000

name: works_api_url
description: OpenAlex API URL listing this author's works. Example: https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=author.id:A5023888391

name: works_count
description: Number of works by this author. Example: 85

name: full_name
description: The author's full name as recorded on the profile. Example: Heather A. Piwowar

name: topics
description: Topics this author has published on most, with the number of works per topic.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the topic. Example: https://openalex.org/T10102

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of this author's works tagged with the topic. Example: 23

fields.name: subfield
fields.description: The subfield this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

fields.name: field
fields.description: The field this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences

name: topic_share
description: Topics weighted by their share of this author's works.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the topic. Example: https://openalex.org/T10102

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the topic. Example: scientometrics and bibliometrics research

fields.name: value
fields.description: Share of this author's works tagged with the topic. Example: 0.0004

fields.name: subfield
fields.description: The subfield this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the subfield. Example: https://openalex.org/subfields/1710

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the subfield. Example: Information Systems

fields.name: field
fields.description: The field this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the field. Example: https://openalex.org/fields/17

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the field. Example: Computer Science, Medicine

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain this topic belongs to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: OpenAlex ID of the domain. Example: https://openalex.org/domains/1

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Name of the domain. Possible values: Life Sciences | Social Sciences | Physical Sciences | Health Sciences
